mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_requests (id, project_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, voice_id, language, speaking_rate, segmentation_version, request_fingerprint, voice_reference_asset_id, project_voice_reference_asset_id) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterRowVersion}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceText}, #{voiceId}, #{language}, #{speakingRate}, #{segmentationVersion}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{accountVoiceReferenceAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectVoiceReferenceAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (request_fingerprint) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, voice_id, language, speaking_rate, segmentation_version, request_fingerprint, voice_reference_asset_id, project_voice_reference_asset_id FROM narration_requests WHERE request_fingerprint = #{requestFingerprint}

SELECT nr.id, nr.project_id, nr.chapter_id, nr.chapter_row_version, nr.source_hash, nr.source_text, nr.voice_id, nr.language, nr.speaking_rate, nr.segmentation_version, nr.request_fingerprint, nr.voice_reference_asset_id, nr.project_voice_reference_asset_id FROM narration_requests nr JOIN narration_operations no ON no.narration_request_id = nr.id WHERE no.generation_job_id = #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_operations (id, narration_request_id, generation_job_id, stage_attempt_id) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{narrationRequestId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{stageAttemptId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT pa.storage_key AS storageKey, pa.mime_type AS contentType, na.duration_ms AS durationMs FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN narration_operations no ON no.generation_job_id = gj.id JOIN narration_requests nr ON nr.id = no.narration_request_id JOIN narration_assets na ON na.narration_request_id = nr.id JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.job_type = 'NARRATION_GENERATE' AND gj.status = 'COMPLETED' AND gj.idempotency_key LIKE 'voice-preview:%' AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.storage_key IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_assets (id, project_id, name, asset_type, storage_key, mime_type, status, metadata_json) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{name}, 'AUDIO', #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, 'ACTIVE', '{}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE project_assets SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT na.id, na.narration_request_id, na.project_asset_id, na.duration_ms, nr.source_hash FROM narration_assets na JOIN narration_requests nr ON nr.id = na.narration_request_id WHERE na.narration_request_id = #{narrationRequestId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT na.id, na.narration_request_id, na.project_asset_id, na.duration_ms, nr.source_hash FROM narration_assets na JOIN narration_requests nr ON nr.id = na.narration_request_id WHERE na.project_asset_id = #{projectAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_assets (id, narration_request_id, project_asset_id, duration_ms, size_bytes, codec, sample_rate_hz, channels, checksum) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{narrationRequestId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{durationMs}, #{sizeBytes}, #{codec}, #{sampleRateHz}, #{channels}, #{checksum})
mapper.update: UPDATE narration_assets SET project_asset_id = #{projectAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, codec = #{codec}, sample_rate_hz = #{sampleRateHz}, channels = #{channels}, checksum = #{checksum}, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_alignments (id, narration_asset_id, source_hash, alignment_version, words_json) VALUES (uuidv7(), #{narrationAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{sourceHash}, #{alignmentVersion}, CAST(#{wordsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (narration_asset_id, alignment_version) DO NOTHING
